_doc: Per-book per-family MARKET FORMAT map (OBTAINABILITY-GATE-1, 2026-07-17). sides: 'over_only' = the book's app sells this family as milestone ladders (1+/2+/3+) — vendor-reported UNDER prices are NOT operator-purchasable and must never be recommended; 'two_sided' = true O/U purchasable in-app. ENFORCEMENT RULE: the served lens drops/re-points under-side picks ONLY for explicit over_only entries — unknown book/family pairs are NEVER guessed into restriction (that would wrongly strip real unders). Every entry carries source + verifiedAt; field verification OUTRANKS vendor data (the vendor carried DK u1.5 Witt at -203 that the app would not sell). Extend as field truth accumulates; changing enforcement = changing this file = a commit.
